_meta.description: Calibrated monthly climate inputs: WMO station normals first, else ERA5 (Open-Meteo).

sources.wmo-9120: WMO Member Nations (2023). WMO Climatological Standard Normals for 1991-2020 (NCEI Accession 0253808). Primary parameters DP01/TMAX/TMIN/TAVG/MNVP + RH (param 38). NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. https://doi.org/10.25921/800j-vn07. Accessed 2026-10-03.
sources.era5-om: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis (model 'era5_seamless') https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive

rainCalibration.target: WMO 1991-2020 DP01 (days >= 1 mm) at station-backed cities
rainCalibration.note: Thresholds chosen by min MAE over all city-months; separate tropical threshold used only if it improves tropical MAE by > 0.5 day.

classes.highland: city >= 1000 m or |ERA5 cell - DEM| >= 250 m

confidenceRules.station: high if <= 20 km and |dz| <= 100 m, else medium (see station-normals _meta)
confidenceRules.reanalysis temp/hum: from ERA5-vs-station MAE in the same city class (temp high <= 1.5 °F, medium <= 3; RH high <= 4, medium <= 8); never above medium for highland/coastal
confidenceRules.reanalysis rain: medium if lowland and fitted MAE <= 2 days, else low
confidenceRules.legacy-estimate: low (old unsourced value kept; ERA5 pending)
